title: Speaking a wish without hidden conditions
meaning: Detailed conversation helps you name a strong expectation and loosen a hidden condition, although emotional uncertainty may remain after the answer.
text: A desired answer can matter so much that simple words gather guesses around them. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha helps a request unfold: describing a wish, finding an example and allowing a full reply. The Devil in energy directs attention towards what binds the freedom of conversation. The constructive move is to acknowledge a clinging expectation honestly and avoid concealing it in a compulsory rule. The Moon in emotions retains uncertainty. Even agreement can feel less than convincing, so admitting a wish and feeling reassured may arrive separately.

Suppose you ask to discuss an invitation before accepting it for an evening you hoped to keep for yourselves. An answer comes, but its tone leaves you wondering whether agreement was forced. **A clear request leaves room for a real answer.** You can explain why the evening matters and still hear another wish. Spoken words give the exchange some footing while feelings catch up with the agreement.

The difficulty appears if every nuance prompts another check. Questions become more detailed while freedom to answer shrinks: reassurance depends on one acceptable reaction. The wish for honesty remains, but feeling starts to dictate the exchange. Distinguishing what was said from what is imagined lets uncertainty be acknowledged without an endless demand for another assurance.
